title: Viewpoint
promptLabel: Scene Viewpoint (overrides the story perspective for this scene only)

options.label: Neutral
options.prompt: Neutral, objective narrator who observes from outside and does not enter any character's head
options.description: A detached camera-eye narrator reporting only what can be seen and heard.

options.label: Omniscient
options.prompt: Omniscient narrator who may move freely between characters' thoughts and comment on events beyond their knowledge
options.description: A knowing narrator with access to every mind and to the wider world.
